Vanessa — quick summary of automated triage: see attached heatmap and CSV. Highlights:
- 7 signups in the last 3 days with high cosine similarity on device fingerprints; cluster score 0.88 (likely same browser/automation).
- 5 of the 7 emails are on disposable domains (maildrop.xyz, tmpmail.pro, rapidmail.cc).
- IPs resolve to two nearby /24 subnets within AS396073 (mobile carrier network) — suspicious for proxying but could be developer phones; risk elevated.
- One signup used a corporate-sounding address (peter.l@mosaicanalytics.com) but the confirmation link was never clicked.

Recommendation: do NOT issue a blanket 7-day unlimited credit. Offer a gated path: a small evaluation top-up (1,000 tokens, 72 hours) or full extension contingent on proof of corporate affiliation (company DOC + verification email) and confirmation of domain ownership (MX check).
